visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female presenter with brown hair tied back and a friendly expression speaks to the camera. She wears a black and white striped shirt and a black apron. A white pedestal fan is visible to her left in a well-lit living room with a couch and plants. Her hand gestures are active and expressive as she introduces the product. (2) Close-up shots focus on the fan's disassembly. A finger points to the red alignment marks on the motor housing. The hands easily twist and remove the front guard and the fan blade without using any tools. The background shows a neutral, modern home interior with soft lighting and a blurred TV screen. (3) The scene moves to a kitchen sink where the disassembled fan parts are washed. A pull-down faucet sprays water directly onto the white plastic grill and blades. The water flow is clear and vigorous, effectively removing visible dust. Text overlays describe the process in traditional Chinese characters while the character holds the objects. (4) A vertical split-screen comparison is displayed for several seconds. The top section shows a close-up of a dusty fan grill labeled as the 'before' state. The bottom section shows the same grill after washing, appearing pristine and white, labeled as the 'after' state. This effectively visualizes the product's main functional selling point. (5) The presenter demonstrates the reassembly of the fan, clicking the parts back together with ease. She then holds up a small, white rectangular remote control to the camera, showing its buttons. She also adjusts the height of the fan by sliding the telescopic pole upwards and downwards to show the range of motion. (6) A wider shot shows the fan operating in a living room environment. It performs a 360-degree oscillation, moving its head both horizontally and vertically in a smooth motion. Graphic text overlays highlight technical specifications such as the seven speed levels and the long-distance airflow capabilities. (7) A promotional graphic appears showing two color options for the fan: Obsidian Black and Snowrock White side-by-side. The presenter returns to the screen, smiling and pointing downwards to indicate where viewers can find more information or make a purchase. The lighting remains bright and inviting throughout the entire sequence.

The vocal narration remains continuous and energetic, while the BGM maintains a steady, moderate volume level. Another percussive 'thud' and 'click' are heard as fan parts are handled. The BGM continues to provide a cheerful atmosphere in the background. Mechanical sounds of plastic parts clicking together are clearly audible during the reassembly segment. The audio quality is clean and studio-like. The track ends with a final melodic stinger and a gradual fade-out of the acoustic guitar loop, leaving a brief moment of silence.
